title: Super Yangians in characteristic $2$
summary: We define the super Yangian $Y_{m|n}$ over a field $\mathbbm{k}$ of characteristic $2$, and show that the super Yangian $Y_{m|n}$ is a deformation of the super universal enveloping algebra of the current Lie algebra $\mathfrak{gl}_{m+n}[t]$. By employing the methods of the work of \cite{BT18}, we also give a description of the center of $Y_{m|n}$.
